CustomObject.description: One row per banker, per CRM cockpit metric, per day: the history behind the React cockpits' CRM sparklines and deltas (pipeline, open opportunities, leads, open cases, goals, pipeline by stage). Written nightly by CockpitKpiSnapshot (Schedulable); the 8-week backfill reconstructs past days from record dates. Upserted on Unique_Key__c.
